prDescription: Introduces a dashboard that loads active users and metrics in one component.

reviewQuality.summary: A single React component now fetches multiple resources, derives UI state inline, and renders unrelated concerns together.
reviewQuality.reviewGoal: Prioritise the structural maintainability problem over incidental performance commentary. A strong review should focus on the mixed concerns and suggest a decomposition path.

mustFind.description: Flags the component as mixing fetching, transformation, and rendering responsibilities

mustAvoid.description: Avoids leading with a minor sorting/memoisation nit as the main comment

prioritise.description: The top comment should be about the god-component concern

dimensions.name: correctness
dimensions.description: Did the review identify the real maintainability issue rather than a secondary optimisation?

dimensions.name: refactoring-depth
dimensions.description: Does the recommendation suggest a credible decomposition path, not just a label like SRP?

dimensions.name: restraint
dimensions.description: Did the review avoid over-commenting on lower-value issues once the main issue was covered?
